projects.name: Samuel Carranza's Portfolio
projects.description: Collaborative project to create a photography and video portfolio. My contribution focused mainly on implementing the i18n structure, developing the Hero, and building the entire portfolio section, including image galleries, videos, and a featured content section. I also developed the gallery interaction logic, including fullscreen content viewing.
projects.imageAlt: View of Samuel's portfolio featuring a photography gallery

projects.name: Avocado
projects.description: Thesis project for the Web Development Technical Degree. Avocado is a mobile and web application for creating, sharing, and discovering recipes. My contribution focused mainly on backend development and database modeling, as well as participating in mobile development by creating views and integrating them with the backend.
